proof_body:
by
  intro f a hf
  have hi : ∀ s t : ℝ, a ≤ s → a ≤ t → IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume s t := fun s t hs ht =>
    (hf.mono fun x hx => (le_min hs ht).trans hx.1).intervalIntegrable
  have hsub : ∀ s t : ℝ, a ≤ s → a ≤ t → (∫ x in a..t, f x) - ∫ x in a..s, f x = ∫ x in s..t, f x := fun s t hs ht =>
    intervalIntegral.integral_interval_sub_left (hi a t le_rfl ht) (hi a s le_rfl hs)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩ ε hε
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 (hL.eventually (Metric.ball_mem_nhds L (half_pos hε)))
    refine ⟨max T a, le_max_right _ _, fun s t hs ht => ?_⟩
    have hsa : a ≤ s := (le_max_right _ _).trans hs
    have hta : a ≤ t := (le_max_right _ _).trans ht
    rw [← hsub s t hsa hta, ← Real.dist_eq]
    have h1 := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hT s ((le_max_left _ _).trans hs))
    have h2 := Metric.mem_ball.1 (hT t ((le_max_left _ _).trans ht))
    exact (dist_triangle_right _ _ L).trans_lt (by linarith)
  · intro h
    have hc : Cauchy (Filter.map (fun t => ∫ x in a..t, f x) Filter.atTop) := by
      refine Metric.cauchy_iff.2 ⟨inferInstance, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨T, hTa, hT⟩ := h ε hε
      refine ⟨(fun t => ∫ x in a..t, f x) '' Set.Ici T, Filter.image_mem_map (Filter.Ici_mem_atTop T), ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      rw [Real.dist_eq, hsub t s (hTa.trans ht) (hTa.trans hs)]
      exact hT t s ht hs
    exact cauchy_map_iff_exists_tendsto.1 hc
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a : ℝ), ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici a) → ((∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun t => ∫ x in a..t, f x) Filter.atTop (nhds L)) ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ T : ℝ, a ≤ T ∧ ∀ s t : ℝ, T ≤ s → T ≤ t → |∫ x in s..t, f x| < ε)
